metadata.name: SearchCard
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to search card.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of search record which can be view in one Batch. 50 is default value Valid Values:0-9 Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page. 0 is default value. Valid Values:0-9 Example:12

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Client ID of the client. Valid Values:0-9 Example:485214

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: Product ID Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: Specific code assigned to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234

request_fields.name: CustomerType
request_fields.description: Type of Customer. Valid Values: 01 = Individual 02 = Organization 03 = Anonymous 04 = Funder 06 = Recipient 07 = Owning Partner 08 = Partner Store 09 = Purged 10 = Register Example: Individual / Organization etc. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Example:4851455

request_fields.name: CardType
request_fields.description: Specifies the type of Card. Valid Values: 0 = Primary Card 1 = Secondary Card 2 = Virtual Secondary Card Example:0 = Primary Card Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ApplicationID
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the ApplicationID Valid Values:0-9 Example:12345

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for the transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Example:23654789

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example:02/01/2020

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Example : John Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Example : Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CardNumberLast4Digit
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 4

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Example:4851455

children.name: MaskedCardNumber
children.description: Masked Card Number. For security purposes, the card number always displays partially masked with only the first six and last four numbers in the clear. Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456XXXXXX1234 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: Card Sequence Number. Physical Card order can be uniquely identify by combination of Admin Number and Card Sequence Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example : 1

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:John J Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardStatus
children.description: Status of the requested card. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Example: New Card Pending Activation. Cancelled etc Allowable Values: 100

children.name: IssueStatus
children.description: Status of the Issued Card. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Requested To Be Embossed. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardIssueDate
children.description: Date on which card issued. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/02/2020

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Date when card is be expired. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 07/31/2025

children.name: LastNameOnCard
children.description: Last name of card holder embossed on card. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example:ABC, AB12 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CancelStatus
children.description: Reason for card cancellation. Valid Values: 1 = Closed by Credit 2 = Closed by Customer 3 = Closed Inactive Account 4 = Closed Deceased Customer 5 = Cancelled Not Reissued 6 = Cancelled Never Activated 7 = Cancelled Lost Card 8 = Cancelled Stolen Card 9 = Cancelled ATM Capture 10 = Cancelled Excessive PIN Attempts 11 = New Card Activated 12 = Cancelled - Expired Card 13 = Cancelled - Card Order 14 = Shipping Error Example: 1

children.name: DeliveryDate
children.description: Date of Delivery Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 12/24/2019 08:05:12

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Unique ID associated with Customer. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values: 0-9 Example:12345

children.name: CardType
children.description: Specifies the type of Card. Valid Values: 0 = Primary Card 1 = Secondary Card 2 = Virtual Secondary Card Example:0 = Primary Card
